text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Nurses Registration (Nursing Board for Brunei) Regulations.
The Nursing Board for Brunei is hereby constituted.

(1) In the absence of the chairman from any meeting of the Board, the members present shall elect from amongst themselves a person to be the chairman for that meeting.

(2) Eight members present shall form the quorum of a meeting.

(3) Subject to these Regulations, the Board may determine its own procedure.
